mapper.select: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_ID AS departmentId, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS departmentName, COUNT(e.EMPLOYEE_ID) AS employeeCount, COALESCE(AVG(e.SALARY), 0) AS averageSalary FROM DEPARTMENT d LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_ID, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_ID
